subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose the generic outbound-echo identity registry through the public plugin SDK after the return-type regression is corrected?
rationale: The PR adds public cross-plugin API rather than only repairing Discord internals; repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Approve the generic SDK seam after the type fix
options.body: Keep the core-owned registry and public helpers, but require corrected drop-capable overloads and focused compatibility coverage before merge.

options.title: Keep echo suppression Discord-local
options.body: Avoid the new public SDK commitment by restoring an owner-local Discord solution if generic cross-channel adoption is not intended.

recommendation.title: Approve the generic SDK seam after the type fix
recommendation.body: Keep the core-owned registry and public helpers, but require corrected drop-capable overloads and focused compatibility coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR history shows direct ownership of the proposed channel and SDK boundary.
